mapper.sql: SELECT id, hazard_point_id, hazard_point_name, device_id, (SELECT d.name FROM device d WHERE d.id = alarm_record.device_id) AS device_name, sensor_id, monitor_content_id, alarm_level, alarm_level_text, alarm_type, alarm_message, criteria_id, strategy_id, current_value, threshold_value, trigger_conditions, first_trigger_time, last_trigger_time, trigger_count, status, status_name, resolved_by, resolved_at, resolution_note, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM alarm_record
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_record (hazard_point_id, hazard_point_name, device_id, sensor_id, monitor_content_id, alarm_level, alarm_level_text, alarm_type, alarm_message, criteria_id, strategy_id, current_value, threshold_value, trigger_conditions, first_trigger_time, last_trigger_time, trigger_count, status, status_name, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{hazardPointId}, #{hazardPointName}, #{deviceId}, #{sensorId}, #{monitorContentId}, #{alarmLevel}, #{alarmLevelText}, #{alarmType}, #{alarmMessage}, #{criteriaId}, #{strategyId}, #{currentValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{triggerConditions}, #{firstTriggerTime}, #{lastTriggerTime}, #{triggerCount}, #{status}, #{statusName}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_record SET last_trigger_time = #{lastTriggerTime}, trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, alarm_message = #{alarmMessage}, current_value = #{currentValue}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE alarm_record SET alarm_level = #{alarmLevel}, alarm_level_text = #{alarmLevelText}, last_trigger_time = #{lastTriggerTime}, trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, alarm_message = #{alarmMessage}, current_value = #{currentValue}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE alarm_record SET status = #{status}, status_name = #{statusName}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE hazard_point_id = #{hazardPointId} AND status IN (1, 2)

SELECT ar.alarm_level AS alarmLevel, ar.alarm_level_text AS alarmLevelText, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alarm_record ar WHERE ar.status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY ar.alarm_level, ar.alarm_level_text ORDER BY ar.alarm_level

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(td.trigger_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN td.alarm_level = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level1, SUM(CASE WHEN td.alarm_level = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level2, SUM(CASE WHEN td.alarm_level = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level3, SUM(CASE WHEN td.alarm_level = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level4, COUNT(*) AS total FROM alarm_record_trigger_detail td WHERE td.trigger_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(td.trigger_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status IN (3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS historyCount, COALESCE(SUM(ar.trigger_count), 0) AS totalCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record_trigger_detail td WHERE td.trigger_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)), 0) AS recentThreeMonthsCount FROM alarm_record ar

SELECT ar.hazard_point_name AS hazardPointName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alarm_record_trigger_detail td INNER JOIN alarm_record ar ON td.alarm_record_id = ar.id WHERE ar.status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY ar.hazard_point_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(mt.id, 0) AS monitorTypeId, COALESCE(mt.name, '未知') AS monitorTypeName, COALESCE(mt.sort_order, 999) AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alarm_record ar LEFT JOIN device_sensor ds ON ar.sensor_id = ds.id AND ds.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN monitor_type mt ON ds.monitor_type_id = mt.id AND mt.del_flag = 0 WHERE ar.status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY mt.id, mt.name, mt.sort_order ORDER BY mt.sort_order
SELECT td.alarm_level AS alarmLevel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alarm_record_trigger_detail td GROUP BY td.alarm_level ORDER BY td.alarm_level

SELECT COALESCE(mt.id, 0) AS monitorTypeId, COALESCE(mt.name, '未知') AS monitorTypeName, COALESCE(mt.sort_order, 999) AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alarm_record_trigger_detail td INNER JOIN alarm_record ar ON td.alarm_record_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN device_sensor ds ON ar.sensor_id = ds.id AND ds.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN monitor_type mt ON ds.monitor_type_id = mt.id AND mt.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY mt.id, mt.name, mt.sort_order ORDER BY mt.sort_order
